description: Mediation Boards Commission - Calling for nominations for the appointments of Chairmen and Mediators of Panels of Mediators of Gampaha and 10 other Administrative Districts
categorisation: This gazette notice concerns the appointment of mediators to judicial mediation boards, falling under judicial/law enforcement matters. It involves calling for nominations for judicial officers (mediators) to serve on specific mediation boards across various districts, issued by the Mediation Boards Commission under the Mediation Boards Act. This fits Type 9 as it deals with judicial appointments and the administration of alternative dispute resolution mechanisms within the judicial system.
